# Lint Rules

Every finding notaio reports carries one of these codes, in the controller's status, in its Events and in `notaio lint`. The codes are stable: a rule is never renumbered, and a test fails when one is weakened.

## Policy rules

Checked by the controller and by `notaio lint`, from `crates/sandboxpolicy-core/src/lint.rs`.

| Code | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| `L001` | Unknown knob id |
| `L002` | Step above the loosest step the knob has |
| `L003` | Toxic combination: sensitive data, untrusted content and an outbound channel together |
| `L004` | Lab-only knob relaxed on a profile that is not LabOnly |
| `L005` | Audience set does not fit K5.3, or an audience is malformed or a wildcard |
| `L006` | Write access without K5.2, or token TTL above the K5.1 ceiling |
| `L007` | Egress entry does not fit K4.1 |
| `L008` | Tool entry does not fit K1.3, or is not pinned by digest |
| `L009` | Lease or budget above the K7.3 or K4.3 ceiling |
| `L010` | Policy binds no subjects |
| `L011` | Grant is not exactly one step above the profile, or duplicates another grant |
| `L012` | Grant outlives the maximum lifetime for its target step |
| `L013` | Grant lacks an approval from a required role |
| `L014` | The policy's exposure is not covered by its approved ceiling |
| `L015` | The policy has no approved ceiling |
| `L016` | The ceiling lacks an approval from the `Security` role |
| `L017` | An audience endpoint or rule is malformed |
| `L018` | An endpoint is reachable two ways: in two audiences, or in an audience and direct egress |
| `L019` | A direct egress entry the gateway cannot enforce: method and path rules, or a wildcard host |
| `L020` | A policy on a LabOnly profile exposes an audience its ceiling does not classify LabOnly |
| `L021` | Two ceilings classify the same audience differently |
| `L022` | A team audience with a backend other than `secret` or `none` |
| `L023` | A team audience with an `openbao` source |
| `L024` | A team audience and a platform audience with the same name |
| `L025` | An endpoint held by two audiences visible from one namespace |
| `L026` | A header name that is not a lowercase token or is reserved, or a header value that is not printable ASCII |
| `L027` | A policy grants an audience no definition is visible for, or a team audience from another namespace |
| `L028` | A grant's endpoints, rules or token lifetime wider than its audience's definition |
| `L029` | A team audience placed in the proxy |
| `L031` | Two included policies supply the same audience, egress endpoint or tool, and the including policy does not declare it |
| `L032` | An include that has includes of its own, more than four includes, one named twice, or includes on a policy with `publish: false` |
| `L033` | The including policy's groups are not all in an included policy's groups |
| `L034` | A subject group that is empty, has leading or trailing whitespace, holds a pattern character (`*?[]{}`), or repeats another |

## Input rules

About the set of files given to `notaio lint`, from `crates/notaio/src/lint.rs`.

| Code | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| `I001` | An object in the sandbox.firestoned.io group is not a valid SandboxProfile, SandboxPolicy, KnobGrant, ExposureCeiling or SandboxAudience |
| `I002` | The same object (kind, namespace, name) appears more than once in the inputs |
| `I003` | A policy references a profile that is neither in the inputs nor built in |
| `I004` | A grant references a policy that is not in the inputs |
| `I005` | The compiled content has no RFC 8785 canonical form (ADR-0005) |
| `I006` | A grant has expired |
| `I007` | A policy's profile does not lint clean; the profile's own findings are reported against it |
| `I008` | An ExposureCeiling names a policy that is not in the inputs (ADR-0007) |
| `I009` | An object uses an API version notaio no longer serves: write it as v1alpha2 (ADR-0013) |
| `I010` | A SandboxAudience has no namespace: the namespace decides whether it is a platform or a team audience (ADR-0020) |
| `I011` | SandboxAudience objects in the inputs, but no platform audience namespace: their rules were not checked |
| `I012` | A policy includes a policy that is not in the inputs, in its namespace (ADR-0023) |
